final_rationale: The verdict changes only because the Actor narrowed the position to a policy-bounded one; no new admissible evidence was added. The admissible record still shows that the patent prior-art triage segment is a named launch use case tied to two legal-technology commitments, misses target by 1.3 percentage points, and remains under open legal review, while policy requires disclosure or approved risk acceptance for material limitations affecting named launch use cases. That unresolved predicate still blocks a clean compliance finding. However, the Actor no longer defends clean nondisclosure and instead conditions certification on explicit limitation disclosure or approved risk acceptance before launch. That caveated position is materially different from claiming the present record already supports unqualified certification, and it is proportional to the aggregate-readiness evidence showing a 2.0-point launch-readiness pass and no severity-one rehearsal incidents. So the narrowed position is supportable as compliant_with_caveats, not compliant.
remaining_concerns: No admissible evidence shows the named-use-case limitation has already been disclosed in launch documentation.
No admissible evidence shows approved risk acceptance covering this limitation before launch.
Legal review remains open on whether the patent prior-art triage gap must be disclosed.
The policy predicate is still unresolved on the present record, so only a conditioned certification posture is supportable.
